audit_items.proof_trace: Move's type system enforces the invariant: ObligationOwnerCap has `key, store` but NOT `copy`, so the VM cannot duplicate it. The only struct literal constructor (`ObligationOwnerCap { ... }`) exists exclusively at L63 inside module `protocol::obligation`, and Move's module-private field access rules prevent external construction. Every call to `obligation::new()` atomically creates one fresh obligation and exactly one cap bound to it via `object::id(&obligation)`, and the obligations table uses the obligation ID as key (aborting on collision), providing a secondary guard.
